label: Editorial
title: RESET makes the case for the one-person AI film crew
excerpt: Max Barskih's RESET — written, directed, and entirely produced solo using Higgsfield AI — is the clearest sign yet that a single filmmaker can now credibly deliver a multi-location sci-fi short without a crew.
body: Max Barskih's RESET — written, directed, and entirely produced solo using Higgsfield AI — is the clearest sign yet that a single filmmaker can now credibly deliver a multi-location sci-fi short without a crew. Its selection at the Higgsfield Global Film Festival says less about novelty and more about craft: the lunar throne-room confrontation holds up as a piece of staging, not just a technical demo.
